# Archive Mosaic DataLink Captures

These are unmodified metadata responses and discovery receipts from explicit
requests on 2026-10-23. The receipt in each directory records the Member, requested
ASDM, request URL, timing, response size, and SHA-256.

- `7m/`: SPT0303-59, six Member-level product records.
- `12m/`: NGC5248, seven Member-level product records.

No science products were downloaded. Auxiliary links are uninspected candidates;
these captures do not validate listobs contents, ASDM binding, or Member inventory
completeness. The receipts precede addition of the optional HTTP-status result
field and are retained unchanged. Offline tests verify their response hashes.
